item.title: Republic Day rehearsals continue at India Gate amid dense fog in Delhi
item.description: NEW DELHI: Preparations for the upcoming Republic Day celebrations are in full swing at India Gate, with rehearsals continuing despite dense fog enveloping the National Capital Region. item.title: Stock market starts 2026 on positive note; Sensex climbs over 200 points
